title: The NBA wants to embrace content creators without degrading its golden goose of live sports rights
raw_text:
Key Points
- The NBA welcomed more than 200 content creators to All-Star weekend as the league attempts to connect with younger viewers.
- CNBC Sport spoke with one of the NBA's most popular content creators, Jesser, in an exclusive interview.
- Jesser predicted one way to merge the value of live rights with content creation is to have many new alternative broadcast options in the coming years.
